title: ID0453021-DC/Si-D/GB-[Y2/S0 313946048/001] Castles terminal issue
description:
Reported behavior/issue- Castles terminal with Neftis not recognised by charger - terminal has IP address 10.20.17.50
Solution:
Terminal is added to a charger, the terminal <must> be fully configured <before> the charger is configured to connect to it.
2025-10-02-
Worked by Marcelo

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0453021-DC/Si-D/GB-[Y2/S0 313946048/001] Castles terminal issue CRM:02889000691
additional_info.body:
Please close the ticket – problem solved.
For future reference – when the Castle Neftis Terminal is added to a charger, the terminal <must> be fully configured <before> the charger is configured to connect to it.
If the charger tries to connect before the terminal has an IP address, the MQTT messaging breaks and the charger needs to be configured to -no terminal- and then back to -castles UPT1000 Neftis-
Thanks,
Jason
